_provenance.note: Arm-independent: no model and no human judgement. recall_ceiling is the fraction of authored header edges also stated in prose, and is the hard upper bound on recall for any prose extractor. An edge counts as restated if EITHER end states it: of the 8 restated edges, 3 are stated by the superseded PEP itself and 5 are stated only by the successor. That split matters because build_gold.py hashes only the superseded PEP's body as the frozen question's input, so the 3 figure is the one describing the superseded document alone; for the other 5, the sentence this census counted is not in that input.
